name: Vaultwarden
description: Vaultwarden is a light server for the Bitwarden apps. A team keeps its passwords on its own server and uses the Bitwarden apps and browser extensions to reach them.
licence_note: Free to self-host. If you change its code and offer it as a service, you must share your changes.
whats_new: The first version of the template.
first_steps: Open the address of the app with /admin at its end, and sign in with the token in the environment variable ADMIN_TOKEN (Environment, Reveal). Invite each user there; a user then opens /#/signup and registers with the invited email.
